### She Laughs
Author: Robin Jones
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/she-laughs-encouragement-caf-january-30-2019.html
Passage: Genesis 21:6
Points:
- Sarah and Abraham initially responded with skeptical laughter when told they would have a child in old age.
- God turned their disbelief into authentic joy when Sarah gave birth to Isaac.
- Isaac’s miraculous birth advanced God's redemptive plan that ultimately culminated in Jesus Christ.
- Children are gracious gifts from God that bring joy and light during difficult seasons.
- Preserving joyful family moments helps believers remember God’s faithfulness and sense of humor.

### Just as Promised
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/just-promised
Passage: Genesis 21:1-3
Points:
- God proved His absolute trustworthiness by visiting Sarah and fulfilling His covenant promise of a son.
- Isaac’s birth demonstrates that God accomplishes what is humanly impossible for elderly and barren parents.
- The arrival of Isaac carried forward the covenant lineage pointing toward Abraham's greatest descendant, Christ.
- While waiting on God can feel like an eternity, His timing is always perfect and purposeful.
- Christians can be confident that God will reliably complete the good work He began in them.
